references.role: a real photograph of the exact motorcycle model to depict, a Honda CG 150 Titan-class commuter (match its round headlight, flat one-piece seat, silver tank and side covers, exposed chrome-and-black engine and spoked wheels)

props.name: Motorcycle
props.front: front view of a Honda CG 150-class commuter motorcycle: round headlight, wide flat handlebars, front fork and spoked front wheel, silver tank visible behind; plain, no logos or readable text
props.back: rear view of the same motorcycle: small plain black rear top-box on its rear rack, tail light, rear spoked wheel; plain, no logos or readable text

extra_panels.title: LEFT side (the side that faces the security camera in the shot)
extra_panels.description: the whole motorcycle seen from its LEFT side with its FRONT wheel, headlight and handlebars pointing to the LEFT of the panel and its rear wheel and black top-box to the right, parked on its sidestand which is down on this left side, leaning slightly toward the viewer, on wet dark asphalt in a light drizzle

extra_panels.title: RIGHT side
extra_panels.description: the whole motorcycle seen from its RIGHT side with its front wheel pointing to the RIGHT of the panel, no sidestand visible, standing upright-leaning on the far side stand, the same silver-and-black colors and small black top-box
